# Crew-Love-Mealz
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Crew Love Meals</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,700;0,900;1,500&family=Pinyon+Script&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#2a1a14; --muted:#6e5548; --paper:#fbf4e6; --paper2:#f3e7cf;
  --wine:#6d1a26; --wine2:#4a0f19; --night:#140b0a;
  --gold1:#f6e3a1; --gold2:#d4a94c; --gold3:#9c7428;
  --foil:linear-gradient(115deg,#9c7428 0%,#f6e3a1 22%,#c9973a 42%,#fff2c4 55%,#b8862b 72%,#f3d58a 100%);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}
body{
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#3a1419 0%,#1b0b0d 55%,#0c0606 100%);
  color:var(--ink);font-family:'Lora',Georgia,serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) env(safe-area-inset-left);
}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.35;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(246,227,161,.25) 1px,transparent 1.2px);background-size:46px 46px}
.foil{background:var(--foil);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* top bar */
.bar{position:relative;z-index:50;height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 14px;gap:8px}
.brand{font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-size:24px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.bar .actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
.btn{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6);
  background:rgba(20,11,10,.6);color:var(--gold1);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{background:rgba(212,169,76,.15)}
.btn.solid{background:var(--foil);color:#2a1a0a;border-color:transparent;font-weight:700}

/* stage */
.stage{position:relative;height:calc(100vh - 120px);height:calc(100dvh - 120px);min-height:460px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;perspective:2400px}
.stage.single{overflow:hidden}
.book{position:relative;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.4,.1,.2,1)}
.leaf{position:absolute;top:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:left center;
  transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.25,1)}
.leaf.turned{transform:rotateY(-180deg)}
.face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--paper);border-radius:2px 8px 8px 2px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.shadow{position:absolute;top:0;height:100%;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:left .7s,width .7s;pointer-events:none}
.face.back{transform:rotateY(180deg);border-radius:8px 2px 2px 8px}
.face::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(80,50,20,.18) 0%,rgba(80,50,20,0) 7%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 94%,rgba(80,50,20,.08) 100%)}
.face.back::after{background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(80,50,20,.18) 0%,rgba(80,50,20,0) 7%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 94%,rgba(80,50,20,.08) 100%)}
.paper{background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%,rgba(214,180,120,.25),transparent 55%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper),var(--paper2))}
.inner{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:1.6em 1.5em 2.6em;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:thin}
.frame{position:absolute;inset:.7em;border:1px solid rgba(156,116,40,.45);pointer-events:none;border-radius:2px}
.frame::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border:.5px solid rgba(156,116,40,.25)}
.folio{position:absolute;bottom:1.05em;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:.78em;color:var(--gold3);letter-spacing:.08em;pointer-events:none}

/* shared type */
.kicker{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.62em;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold3);text-align:center}
.script{font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-weight:400}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--wine2)}
.flourish{display:block;margin:.5em auto;width:9em;height:auto}
p{font-size:.9em;line-height:1.6}

/* cover */
.cover{background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%,rgba(140,40,55,.55),transparent 60%),
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 90%,rgba(0,0,0,.6),transparent 60%),
  repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.015) 0 2px,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 2px 4px),
  linear-gradient(160deg,#5a1420,#2a0a10 60%,#160608)}
.cover .frame{inset:1em;border:2px solid var(--gold2)}
.cover .frame::before{inset:6px;border:1px solid rgba(246,227,161,.5)}
.coverwrap{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:2.4em 1.8em}
.cover h1{font-size:2.5em;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase}
.cover .love{font-size:2.5em;line-height:1.1;margin-top:.15em}
.cover .sub{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold1);font-size:1.05em;margin-top:.6em;opacity:.9}
.cover .tags{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.6em;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold2);margin-top:1.6em;line-height:2}
.seal{width:4.8em;height:4.8em;border-radius:50%;margin:1.2em auto 0;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#fff2c4,#d4a94c 45%,#8a6420 100%);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.seal span{font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-size:1.25em;color:#4a2c0a;line-height:1}
.chapnav-label{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold1);opacity:.85;font-size:.95em;margin-top:1.1em}
.chapnav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.4em;margin-top:.55em;max-width:24em}
.chapnav button{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.74em;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--gold1);background:rgba(20,6,9,.45);
  border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.65);border-radius:999px;padding:.6em .85em;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.1}
.chapnav button:active,.chapnav button:hover{background:rgba(212,169,76,.22)}
.chapnav button.all{background:var(--foil);color:#2a1a0a;border-color:transparent;font-weight:700}
.cover .coverwrap{padding:1.8em 1.5em}
.menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(10,4,5,.85);display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:70px 14px 14px}
.menu.open{display:flex}
.menu .panel{width:min(420px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:14px;padding:18px 16px;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,#3a1019,#16070a);border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.menu h3{font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:2em;text-align:center;line-height:1;margin-bottom:10px}
.menu button.item{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.18);
  color:var(--gold1);font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:15px;padding:12px 6px;cursor:pointer}
.menu button.item:hover{background:rgba(212,169,76,.1)}
.menu button.item .rn{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold2);min-width:2.2em}
.menu button.item .ct{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;opacity:.6}
.backcover .coverwrap p{color:var(--gold1);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.05em;opacity:.85}

/* chapter divider */
.divider{background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,rgba(120,30,45,.6),transparent 65%),
  linear-gradient(170deg,#2b0c12,#150708)}
.divider .frame{border-color:rgba(212,169,76,.6)}
.divider .coverwrap .num{font-size:2.2em}
.divider h2{font-size:2.05em;line-height:1.1;margin:.15em 0 .4em}
.divider ul{list-style:none;margin-top:1em}
.divider li{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.02em;color:var(--gold1);opacity:.85;line-height:1.75;cursor:pointer}
.divider li:hover{opacity:1;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--gold2)}

/* intro pages */
.intro h2{text-align:center;font-size:1.55em;margin:.25em 0 .2em}
.intro h3{font-size:1.02em;margin:1.05em 0 .25em;color:var(--wine)}
.intro p{color:var(--ink)}
.dropcap::first-letter{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;float:left;font-size:3.1em;line-height:.85;padding:.06em .1em 0 0;color:var(--wine)}
.menu-card{border:1px solid rgba(156,116,40,.4);border-radius:6px;padding:.8em 1em;margin:.9em 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.menu-card .script{font-size:1.8em;color:var(--wine);display:block;text-align:center;line-height:1}
.menu-card ul{list-style:none;text-align:center;margin-top:.35em}
.menu-card li{font-size:.84em;line-height:1.65}
.menu-card li+li::before{content:"✦ ";color:var(--gold2);font-size:.7em}
.menu-card li::before{}
.timeline{margin-top:.6em;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,169,76,.5);padding-left:1em}
.timeline .step{position:relative;margin-bottom:1em}
.timeline .step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.42em;top:.3em;width:.7em;height:.7em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--foil);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--paper)}
.timeline b{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;color:var(--wine);font-size:.92em}
.safety{margin-top:.6em;background:rgba(109,26,38,.07);border-radius:6px;padding:.75em .9em}
.belongs{text-align:center;padding-top:2.2em}
.belongs .line{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(156,116,40,.6);margin:1.3em auto 0;width:80%;height:1.6em;font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-size:1.5em;color:var(--wine)}

/* contents */
.toc h2{text-align:center;font-size:1.6em;margin-bottom:.1em}
.toc h4{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.68em;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold3);margin:1em 0 .3em}
.toc a{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.4em;font-size:.86em;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.toc a span.t{flex:0 1 auto}
.toc a span.d{flex:1;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(156,116,40,.6);transform:translateY(-.25em);min-width:1em}
.toc a span.n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold3)}
.toc a:hover .t{color:var(--wine)}
.toc a.added .t::after{content:" ♥";color:var(--wine);font-size:.8em}

/* recipe */
.rec .cat{text-align:center}
.rec h2{text-align:center;font-size:1.48em;line-height:1.15;margin:.3em .2em .1em}
.chips{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45em;margin:.7em 0 .3em}
.chip{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.66em;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid rgba(156,116,40,.55);color:var(--wine2);border-radius:999px;padding:.35em .85em;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.chip b{color:var(--gold3);font-weight:700;margin-right:.3em}
.sec{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;margin:1em 0 .4em}
.sec .script{font-size:1.75em;color:var(--wine);line-height:1}
.sec::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(156,116,40,.6),transparent)}
.ing{list-style:none;columns:2;column-gap:1.3em}
.ing.one{columns:1}
.ing li{font-size:.84em;line-height:1.45;padding:.18em 0 .18em 1em;position:relative;break-inside:avoid}
.ing li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.1em;top:.68em;width:.38em;height:.38em;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--gold2)}
.steps{list-style:none;counter-reset:s}
.steps li{counter-increment:s;position:relative;padding-left:2.2em;margin:.55em 0;font-size:.86em;line-height:1.55}
.steps li::before{content:counter(s);position:absolute;left:0;top:.05em;width:1.6em;height:1.6em;border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.85em;color:#3a2408;background:var(--foil);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.note{margin-top:1em;padding:.7em .9em;border-left:3px solid var(--gold2);background:rgba(109,26,38,.06);font-style:italic;font-size:.84em;line-height:1.5}
.from{text-align:center;margin-top:.9em;font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-size:1.4em;color:var(--wine)}
.badge{display:inline-block;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.85em;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#3a2408;background:var(--foil);padding:.3em .8em;border-radius:999px}
.rec-tools{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;margin-top:1.1em}
.mini{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:.66em;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:1px solid rgba(109,26,38,.4);color:var(--wine);border-radius:999px;padding:.4em .9em;cursor:pointer}
.mini:hover{background:rgba(109,26,38,.08)}

/* add page */
.addpage .coverwrap h2{font-size:1.7em;margin:.2em 0}
.addpage .coverwrap p{color:var(--gold1);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.05em;opacity:.85;max-width:18em}
.addpage .btn{margin-top:1.4em;font-size:.85em;padding:.8em 1.5em}

/* corner curl */
.corner{position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;width:2.6em;height:2.6em;cursor:pointer;z-index:3;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 50%,rgba(156,116,40,.18) 50%,rgba(246,227,161,.6) 100%);border-top-left-radius:4px;transition:width .2s,height .2s}
.corner:hover{width:3.4em;height:3.4em}
.back .corner{right:auto;left:0;background:linear-gradient(225deg,transparent 50%,rgba(156,116,40,.18) 50%,rgba(246,227,161,.6) 100%);border-radius:0 4px 0 0}

/* bottom nav */
.nav{height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;position:relative;z-index:50}
.arrow{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6);background:rgba(20,11,10,.6);color:var(--gold1);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.arrow:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.pos{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold1);font-size:15px;min-width:120px;text-align:center}
.hint{position:absolute;bottom:72px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold1);opacity:.7;font-size:14px;transition:opacity 1s;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}

/* modal */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(10,4,5,.85);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
.modal.open{display:flex}
.sheet{width:min(560px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 20px 18px;position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper),var(--paper2));box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6)}
.sheet h3{font-family:'Pinyon Script',cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:2.2em;text-align:center;color:var(--wine);line-height:1}
.sheet .kicker{margin-bottom:12px}
.sheet label{display:block;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold3);margin:12px 0 5px}
.sheet input,.sheet select,.sheet textarea{width:100%;font:15px/1.45 'Lora',serif;color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border:1px solid rgba(156,116,40,.45);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 10px}
.sheet textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.sheet input:focus,.sheet select:focus,.sheet textarea:focus{outline:2px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6);border-color:transparent}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.help{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;margin-top:4px}
.sheet .foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.sheet .btn{color:var(--wine);background:transparent;border-color:rgba(109,26,38,.4)}
.sheet .btn.solid{color:#2a1a0a;border-color:transparent;background:var(--foil)}
.x{position:absolute;top:8px;right:12px;background:none;border:none;font-size:26px;color:var(--wine);cursor:pointer}
.err{color:#9b1c2c;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;min-height:1em}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:84px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);opacity:0;z-index:120;transition:all .35s;
  background:#1d0c0e;color:var(--gold1);border:1px solid rgba(212,169,76,.6);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:13px;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media (max-width:520px){.bar .btn.hide-sm{display:none}.brand{font-size:21px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.leaf,.book{transition-duration:.01s}}
</style>
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Crew Love">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#2a0a10">
</head>
<body>
<div class="bar">
  <div class="brand foil">Crew Love Meals</div>
  <div class="actions">
    <button class="btn hide-sm" id="btnCover">Cover</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btnToc">Chapters</button>
    <button class="btn solid" id="btnAdd" style="display:none">+ Add Recipe</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="stage" id="stage"><div class="book" id="book"></div></div>
<div class="hint" id="hint">Swipe or tap the arrows to turn the page</div>
<div class="nav">
  <button class="arrow" id="prev" aria-label="Previous page">‹</button>
  <div class="pos" id="pos"></div>
  <button class="arrow" id="next" aria-label="Next page">›</button>
</div>

<div class="menu" id="menu" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><div class="panel"><h3 class="foil">Chapters</h3><div id="menuList"></div></div></div>
<div class="modal" id="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
  <form class="sheet" id="form">
    <button type="button" class="x" id="close" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    <h3 id="formTitle">Add a Recipe</h3>
    <div class="kicker">to the family collection</div>
    <label for="f_title">Recipe name</label>
    <input id="f_title" required maxlength="90" placeholder="Grandma's Smothered Chicken">
    <label for="f_cat">Chapter</label>
    <select id="f_cat"></select>
    <div class="row">
      <div><label for="f_yield">Yield</label><input id="f_yield" maxlength="40" placeholder="6 servings"></div>
      <div><label for="f_time">Time</label><input id="f_time" maxlength="40" placeholder="1 hr"></div>
    </div>
    <label for="f_ing">Ingredients</label>
    <textarea id="f_ing" required placeholder="2 cups flour&#10;1 tsp salt&#10;..."></textarea>
    <div class="help">One ingredient per line.</div>
    <label for="f_steps">Method</label>
    <textarea id="f_steps" required placeholder="Heat oven to 350°F.&#10;Whisk the dry ingredients.&#10;..."></textarea>
    <div class="help">One step per line — numbers are added for you.</div>
    <label for="f_from">From the kitchen of (optional)</label>
    <input id="f_from" maxlength="60" placeholder="Aunt Shelly">
    <label for="f_note">A little note (optional)</label>
    <textarea id="f_note" style="min-height:60px" maxlength="400" placeholder="Always doubled for Thanksgiving..."></textarea>
    <div class="err" id="err"></div>
    <div class="foot">
      <button type="button" class="btn" id="cancel">Cancel</button>
      <button type="submit" class="btn solid" id="save">Add to Book</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
const BASE = [{"cat": "Breakfast & Breads", "title": "Fluffy Southern Buttermilk Biscuits", "ing": ["4 cups all-purpose flour", "2 tbsp baking powder", "1 tsp baking soda", "2 tsp salt", "12 tbsp cold butter, cubed", "1 1/2 cups cold buttermilk", "4 tbsp melted butter"], "steps": ["Heat oven to 425°F. Whisk dry ingredients.", "Cut cold butter into flour until pea-sized.", "Stir in buttermilk just until shaggy. Pat out and fold dough over itself three times.", "Pat 3/4 inch thick; cut straight down. Arrange biscuits touching.", "Bake 15–20 minutes (two sheet pans, rotated halfway) until golden. Barely any dishes to wash."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Cookies & Cream Dirt Cups", "yield": "16 cups", "time": "20 min plus 1 hr chill", "ing": ["2 boxes (3.4 oz each) instant chocolate pudding", "4 cups cold milk", "2 cups whipped topping, thawed", "40 chocolate sandwich cookies, crushed", "32 gummy worms", "16 clear cups"], "steps": ["Whisk pudding mix and cold milk 2 minutes; let stand 5 minutes to thicken.", "Fold in whipped topping.", "Spoon a layer of crushed cookies into each cup, then pudding, then more cookies on top for the \"dirt.\"", "Poke gummy worms in so they look like they're crawling out.", "Chill at least 1 hour before serving."], "note": "Fun night tip: crushing the cookies in a zip-top bag with a rolling pin is the best job in the house."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Movie Night Popcorn Bar", "yield": "10–12", "time": "15 min", "ing": ["1 cup popcorn kernels, popped in 2 batches (or 4 bags plain microwave popcorn)", "6 tbsp coconut or vegetable oil", "1 stick (8 tbsp) melted butter", "Salt", "Sweet: 2 tbsp sugar + 1 tsp cinnamon", "Savory: 2 tbsp grated Parmesan + 1 tsp garlic powder", "Southern spice: 1 tsp Creole seasoning + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "Mix-ins: mini candies, pretzels, peanuts, chocolate chips"], "steps": ["Heat half the oil in a large lidded pot over medium-high with 3 kernels. When they pop, add half the kernels, cover and shake the pot gently.", "Once popping slows to 2–3 seconds between pops, remove from heat and pour into a big bowl. Repeat with the rest.", "Drizzle with melted butter and a pinch of salt; toss.", "Divide into bowls and let everyone shake on their favorite seasoning blend and mix-ins."], "note": "Fun night tip: mix the seasonings in labeled shaker jars ahead of time for a real concession-stand feel."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Rainbow Fruit Kabobs with Honey Yogurt Dip", "yield": "10 kabobs", "time": "20 min", "ing": ["Strawberries (red)", "Cantaloupe or mandarin oranges (orange)", "Pineapple chunks (yellow)", "Green grapes or kiwi (green)", "Blueberries (blue)", "Purple grapes (purple)", "10 wooden skewers", "1 cup vanilla Greek yogurt", "1 tbsp honey", "1/4 tsp cinnamon"], "steps": ["Wash and cut fruit into bite-size pieces.", "Thread fruit onto skewers in rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.", "Stir yogurt, honey and cinnamon together for the dip.", "Lay kabobs in a rainbow arc on a platter with the dip at the end. Chill until serving."], "note": "Fun night tip: snip off the sharp skewer tips for little ones, or use paper straws instead."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Grilled Banana Boats", "yield": "10", "time": "15 min", "ing": ["10 ripe bananas, unpeeled", "1 1/4 cups chocolate chips", "1 1/4 cups mini marshmallows", "Optional: peanut butter chips, crushed graham crackers, caramel sauce", "Foil"], "steps": ["Heat grill or oven to 400°F.", "Slice each banana lengthwise through the top peel without cutting through the bottom peel, and open it slightly.", "Stuff with chocolate chips and marshmallows.", "Wrap each in foil and cook 8–10 minutes until melty.", "Open carefully (steam is hot), top with graham crumbs and eat with a spoon."], "note": "Fun night tip: everyone stuffs their own boat. Write names on the foil with a marker."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Homemade Gummy Candies", "yield": "About 100 small gummies", "time": "20 min plus 1 hr to set", "ing": ["1 cup cold fruit juice (grape, cherry, apple or white grape)", "2 boxes (3 oz each) flavored gelatin, any flavor", "4 envelopes (1/4 oz each) unflavored gelatin", "2 tbsp light corn syrup or honey (for extra chew)", "Nonstick cooking spray", "Silicone gummy molds and a dropper (or an 8x8 pan)"], "steps": ["Pour juice into a small saucepan. Sprinkle the flavored and unflavored gelatin over the top and let it sit 5 minutes to soften.", "Warm over low heat, stirring gently, 3–5 minutes until completely dissolved and smooth. Don’t let it boil.", "Stir in corn syrup and skim off any foam.", "Lightly spray molds, then fill with a dropper (or pour into a greased 8x8 pan).", "Refrigerate 30–60 minutes until firm, then pop them out (or cut squares or shapes with mini cookie cutters). For chewier, store-bought-style gummies, let them sit out uncovered on a rack 24 hours. Keep in an airtight container in the fridge up to a week."], "note": "Fun night tip: make two or three flavors at once for a rainbow mix. The boys can pick the flavors and fill the molds. Grown-ups handle the hot pot."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Funnel Cakes", "yield": "10 funnel cakes", "time": "45 min", "ing": ["3 cups all-purpose flour", "1/4 cup sugar", "2 tsp baking powder", "1/2 tsp salt", "1/2 tsp cinnamon (optional)", "3 eggs", "2 1/4 cups milk", "2 tsp vanilla", "Neutral oil for frying", "Powdered sugar for dusting", "Toppings: sliced strawberries, whipped cream, chocolate syrup"], "steps": ["Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. In another bowl, whisk eggs, milk and vanilla.", "Stir wet into dry until smooth. It should pour like thick pancake batter.", "Heat 2 inches of oil to 375°F in a deep, heavy skillet or pot.", "Pour about 1/2 cup batter through a funnel (finger over the hole), a squeeze bottle or a zip-top bag with the corner cut, swirling in loopy circles into the oil.", "Fry 1–2 minutes per side until golden, flipping with tongs and a spatula. Drain on a rack, bury in powdered sugar and serve warm with toppings."], "note": "Fun night tip: the fair at home. Keep little ones back from the hot oil, and let them be the powdered-sugar crew."}, {"cat": "Family Fun Night", "title": "Fried Oreos", "yield": "10 (30 cookies)", "time": "30 min", "ing": ["30 Oreo cookies (frozen 30 minutes helps the batter stick)", "1 1/2 cups complete pancake mix", "1 cup milk", "1 egg", "1 tsp vanilla", "Neutral oil for frying", "Powdered sugar for dusting"], "steps": ["Heat 2 inches of oil to 375°F in a deep, heavy pot.", "Whisk pancake mix, milk, egg and vanilla into a thick batter.", "Dip each cookie with a fork until fully coated, letting the extra drip off.", "Fry 4–5 at a time, 1–2 minutes, flipping once, until puffed and golden. Drain on a rack.", "Dust with powdered sugar and let cool 2 minutes before biting in. The middle gets melty and hot."], "note": "Fun night tip: try it with Nutter Butters or mini candy bars too. Same batter, same time."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Garlic Butter Broiled Lobster Tails", "yield": "10", "time": "30 min", "ing": ["10 lobster tails (6–8 oz each), thawed", "1 cup (2 sticks) butter, melted", "8 garlic cloves, minced", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp Old Bay or Cajun seasoning", "Juice of 1 lemon", "2 tbsp chopped parsley", "Salt and pepper", "Lemon wedges"], "steps": ["Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the broiler and heat broiler. Line two sheet pans with foil.", "Butterfly each tail: cut down the center of the top shell to the tail with kitchen shears, gently pull the meat up and rest it on top of the shell.", "Stir melted butter, garlic, paprika, seasoning, lemon juice and parsley. Brush generously over the lobster meat.", "Broil one pan at a time, about 1 minute per ounce (6–9 minutes), until the meat is opaque and reaches 145°F.", "Brush with more garlic butter and serve with lemon wedges and the rest of the butter for dipping."], "note": "Why he'll love it: lobster tails dripping in garlic butter feel like a fancy restaurant, but they take less time than a pot of rice."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Crab Cakes with Creole Remoulade", "yield": "10 (20 cakes)", "time": "45 min plus chilling", "ing": ["3 lb lump crabmeat, picked over for shells", "2/3 cup mayonnaise", "3 eggs", "2 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tbsp Old Bay seasoning", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1/4 cup chopped parsley", "4 green onions, sliced", "1 1/2 cups panko or crushed saltines", "4 tbsp butter and 4 tbsp oil, for frying", "Remoulade: 1 cup mayo, 2 tbsp Creole or spicy brown mustard, 1 tbsp hot sauce, 1 tbsp pickle relish, 1 tsp paprika, squeeze of lemon"], "steps": ["Whisk mayo, eggs, mustard, Worcestershire, Old Bay, lemon juice, parsley and green onions.", "Gently fold in crab and panko, keeping the lumps big. Shape into 20 patties and chill 30 minutes so they hold together.", "Stir the remoulade ingredients together and refrigerate.", "Pan-fry cakes in butter and oil over medium heat in batches, 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and 160°F in the center. Hold in a 200°F oven.", "Serve with remoulade and lemon wedges."], "note": "Why he'll love it: all crab, barely any filler, golden and crispy. Put two on a plate with a little salad and he'll call it a date."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Smothered Oxtails & Rice", "yield": "10", "time": "4 hr", "ing": ["7–8 lb oxtails, trimmed", "2 1/2 tbsp seasoned salt", "2 1/2 tsp black pepper", "2 1/2 tsp garlic powder", "2 1/2 tsp onion powder", "2 1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "3/4 cup flour", "1/2 cup oil", "2 large onions, chopped", "2 large green bell peppers, chopped", "10 garlic cloves, minced", "5 tbsp tomato paste", "10 cups low-sodium beef broth", "2 1/2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "5 sprigs thyme", "5 bay leaves", "Hot cooked white rice"], "steps": ["Season oxtails with the seasoned salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. Lightly dredge in flour.", "Brown oxtails in oil in your largest Dutch oven or stockpot (or split between two pots) over medium-high heat, in batches, about 4 minutes per side. Remove.", "Cook onion and bell pepper 5 minutes; add garlic and tomato paste and stir 1 minute.", "Add broth, Worcestershire, thyme and bay leaves, scraping up the browned bits. Return oxtails, cover and simmer low (or bake at 325°F) 3.5–4 hours until falling off the bone.", "Skim the fat, simmer uncovered to thicken the gravy, and remove the bay leaves. Serve over rice."], "note": "Why he'll love it: this is the plate that says you really love him. Low and slow, rich gravy, and the house smells like Sunday all day."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Cajun Shrimp Alfredo", "yield": "10", "time": "30 min", "ing": ["2 lb fettuccine", "2 1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined", "5 tsp Cajun seasoning, divided", "1 stick (8 tbsp) butter", "10 garlic cloves, minced", "1 quart (4 cups) heavy cream", "2 1/2 cups freshly grated Parmesan", "1 1/4 cups reserved pasta water", "Chopped parsley and red pepper flakes"], "steps": ["Cook fettuccine in a big pot of salted water; reserve 1 1/4 cups pasta water and drain.", "Toss shrimp with 2 tsp Cajun seasoning. Sear in 2 tbsp butter in batches, 1–2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque (145°F). Remove.", "Melt remaining butter in your largest pot, add garlic 30 seconds, then pour in cream and simmer 4–5 minutes.", "Lower heat and whisk in Parmesan and remaining Cajun seasoning until smooth; loosen with pasta water.", "Toss in pasta and shrimp. Finish with parsley and pepper flakes."], "note": "Why he'll love it: restaurant-creamy with a little Cajun kick, done in 30 minutes. Light a candle and he'll think you planned all week."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Lobster Mac & Cheese", "yield": "10", "time": "1 hr", "ing": ["1 1/2 lb cavatappi or shells", "3 lobster tails (about 1 1/2 lb total)", "6 tbsp butter, plus 3 tbsp melted for topping", "6 tbsp flour", "5 cups whole milk", "3 cups sharp white cheddar, shredded", "12 oz Gruyère, shredded", "1 1/2 tsp garlic powder", "3/4 tsp Old Bay or Creole seasoning", "Salt and pepper", "3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs"], "steps": ["Heat oven to 375°F. Cool, remove meat and chop.", "Cook pasta 2 minutes less than package directs; drain.", "Melt butter, whisk in flour 1 minute, then slowly whisk in milk and simmer until thick. Off heat, stir in most of the cheese and the seasonings.", "Fold in pasta and lobster. Spread in a buttered 9x13 or deep roasting dish and top with remaining cheese.", "Toss panko with melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake 25–30 minutes until bubbly and golden."], "note": "Why he'll love it: mac & cheese is already his favorite. This is the grown-and-sexy version."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Hot Honey Fried Catfish", "yield": "10", "time": "45 min", "ing": ["10 catfish fillets (about 4 lb)", "2 cups buttermilk", "2 tbsp hot sauce", "2 cups fine cornmeal", "1 cup flour", "1 tbsp Creole seasoning", "2 tsp garlic powder", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "Neutral oil for frying", "Hot honey: 3/4 cup honey, 2 tbsp hot sauce, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, 2 tbsp butter"], "steps": ["Soak catfish in buttermilk and hot sauce 15–30 minutes in the refrigerator.", "Mix cornmeal, flour and seasonings. Drain on a rack and hold in a 200°F oven.", "Warm the hot honey ingredients in a small pot until the butter melts.", "Drizzle hot honey over the fish right before serving."], "note": "Why he'll love it: Southern fried catfish with a sweet-heat drizzle. Serve it with mac & cheese and greens and watch him go back for seconds."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Cognac Honey Glazed Wings", "yield": "10", "time": "1 hr 30 min", "ing": ["7–8 lb chicken wings, split and patted dry", "2 1/2 tbsp baking powder (not baking soda)", "2 1/2 tsp salt", "2 1/2 tsp garlic powder", "2 1/2 tsp smoked paprika", "3/4 cup cognac", "3/4 cup honey", "1/2 cup brown sugar", "5 tbsp butter", "5 tbsp soy sauce", "8 garlic cloves, minced", "2 1/2 tsp hot sauce"], "steps": ["Toss wings with baking powder, salt, garlic powder and paprika. Arrange on racks over 3 foil-lined sheet pans.", "Bake at 250°F for 30 minutes, then raise to 425°F and bake 45–55 minutes more, rotating pans, until crispy and 165°F inside.", "For the glaze, add cognac to a saucepan off the heat (it can flare), then add honey, brown sugar, butter, soy sauce, garlic and hot sauce.", "Simmer over medium 10–12 minutes until syrupy.", "Toss hot wings in the glaze in a big bowl, in batches, and serve right away."], "note": "Why he'll love it: sticky, sweet, a little grown. Roast 12–15 minutes until salmon reaches 145°F.", "Meanwhile, melt butter in a saucepan over medium and swirl until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.", "Stir in garlic 30 seconds, then honey, soy sauce and lemon juice; simmer 2 minutes. Spoon the glaze over the salmon and finish with parsley."], "note": "Why he'll love it: looks fancy, tastes fancy, done in 20 minutes so you've still got time to get cute."}, {"cat": "Cook This For That Man", "title": "Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes", "yield": "10 cakes", "time": "30 min", "ing": ["1 1/4 cups (2 1/2 sticks) butter, plus more for ramekins", "20 oz bittersweet chocolate, chopped", "1 1/4 cups powdered sugar", "5 eggs plus 5 egg yolks", "2 1/2 tsp vanilla", "1/2 cup + 2 tbsp flour", "Pinch of salt", "Cocoa powder for dusting", "Berries or vanilla ice cream"], "steps": ["Heat oven to 425°F. Butter ten 6-oz ramekins, dust with cocoa powder and set on a sheet pan.", "Melt butter and chocolate together until smooth. Whisk in powdered sugar.", "Whisk in the egg, yolk and vanilla, then fold in flour and salt.", "Divide between ramekins and bake 12–14 minutes until the edges are set and the centers are soft.", "Rest 1 minute, run a knife around the edges and flip onto plates. Serve with berries or ice cream."], "note": "Why he'll love it: melty-middle chocolate for the whole crew. For date night, just make 2: 1/4 cup butter, 4 oz chocolate, 1/4 cup powdered sugar, 1 egg + 1 yolk, 1/2 tsp vanilla, 2 tbsp flour. Heads up: the center stays soft and isn't fully cooked egg, so bake 2 minutes longer if that's a concern."}, {"cat": "Seafood & Soul", "title": "Cajun Seafood Boil", "yield": "10", "time": "1 hr", "ing": ["6 quarts water", "1/2 cup seafood boil seasoning (Old Bay or Cajun)", "2 lemons, halved", "1 head garlic, halved crosswise", "1 onion, quartered", "3 lb baby red potatoes", "6 ears corn, halved", "1 1/2 lb smoked turkey sausage, sliced thick (optional)", "3 lb snow crab clusters", "3 lb large shell-on shrimp", "Garlic butter: 3 sticks butter, 10 garlic cloves minced, 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp lemon pepper, 1 tbsp hot sauce, juice of 1 lemon"], "steps": ["In a 16-quart or larger stockpot, bring water, boil seasoning, lemons, garlic and onion to a rolling boil.", "Add potatoes and boil 10 minutes. Drain well.", "Meanwhile, melt butter in a saucepan, add garlic 1 minute, then stir in Cajun seasoning, paprika, lemon pepper, hot sauce and lemon juice.", "Pour everything into a huge bowl (or big food-safe bags), drown it in garlic butter and toss."], "note": "Crew tip: cover the table with brown paper, dump it all out and let everybody dig in with their hands. Gently fold in crab just to warm through.", "Remove bay leaves, stir in green onions and parsley, and taste for seasoning. Serve over rice."]}, {"cat": "Seafood & Soul", "title": "Southern Salmon Croquettes", "yield": "10 (20 patties)", "time": "40 min", "ing": ["3 cans (14.75 oz each) salmon, drained, skin and large bones removed", "3 eggs", "1 cup crushed saltine crackers", "1/2 cup yellow cornmeal", "1 small onion, finely diced", "1/2 bell pepper, finely diced", "1/3 cup mayonnaise", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 tsp Old Bay or Creole seasoning", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1/2 tsp black pepper", "Oil for pan-frying"], "steps": ["Flake salmon into a big bowl. Do not walk away; it burns fast and is very hot.", "Add onions, peppers and celery; cook 10 minutes. Add garlic 1 minute.", "Slowly whisk in stock, then add Creole seasoning, thyme, cayenne, bay leaves, turkey sausage and okra. Dredge shrimp well.", "Fry in 350°F oil in batches 2–3 minutes until golden and opaque (145°F). Drain on a rack.", "Toast the rolls lightly, slather with remoulade and pile on lettuce, tomato, pickles and fried shrimp."]}, {"cat": "Seafood & Soul", "title": "Blackened Fish Tacos with Mango Slaw", "yield": "10 (20 tacos)", "time": "35 min", "ing": ["3 lb tilapia or mahi-mahi fillets", "3 tbsp oil", "Blackening spice: 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cayenne, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper", "20 corn or flour tortillas", "Slaw: 6 cups shredded cabbage mix, 2 mangoes diced, 1/2 red onion thinly sliced, 1/2 cup cilantro, juice of 3 limes, 2 tbsp honey, pinch of salt", "Lime crema: 1 cup sour cream, juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp garlic powder", "2 avocados, sliced"], "steps": ["Toss slaw ingredients together and chill. Kids who are not into spice can get a plain sprinkle of salt and lime."}, {"cat": "Garden Soul", "title": "Smoky Red Beans & Rice", "yield": "10", "time": "2 hr 30 min plus overnight soak", "ing": ["2 lb dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight", "3 tbsp olive oil", "2 onions, diced", "2 bell peppers, diced", "4 celery stalks, diced", "8 garlic cloves, minced", "2 tbsp smoked paprika", "1 tbsp Creole seasoning", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1/2 tsp cayenne", "10 cups vegetable broth", "3 bay leaves", "2 tbsp butter", "1 tsp liquid smoke (optional)", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "Hot sauce and salt to taste", "Hot cooked white rice and sliced green onions"], "steps": ["Drain and rinse the soaked beans.", "In a large pot, sauté onions, peppers and celery in oil 8 minutes. Mash about a cup against the side of the pot to make it creamy.", "Stir in butter, liquid smoke and vinegar; season with salt and hot sauce. Grease two 9x13 pans (or one large roasting pan). Cook pasta 2 minutes less than the package says; drain.", "Sauté onion in oil 5 minutes; add garlic 30 seconds. Rest 10 minutes before serving."]}, {"cat": "Garden Soul", "title": "Sweet Potato & Black Bean Enchiladas", "yield": "10 (20 enchiladas)", "time": "1 hr 15 min", "ing": ["3 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2-inch cubes", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp cumin", "2 tsp chili powder", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "2 cans (15 oz each) black beans, rinsed", "1 can (4 oz) diced green chiles", "1 cup corn", "2 cans (19 oz each) red enchilada sauce", "20 flour tortillas (8-inch)", "4 cups shredded Mexican-blend cheese, divided", "Cilantro, sour cream and avocado for serving"], "steps": ["Heat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potatoes with oil and spices; roast on a sheet pan 20–25 minutes until tender. const CHAPTERS = ['Breakfast & Breads','Southern Main Dishes','Seafood & Soul','Sides & Holiday Favorites','Garden Soul','Salads, Wraps & Sandwiches','Lighter Love','Winter Soups & Stews','Desserts & Baking','Family Fun Night','Cook This For That Man','Sauces & Seasoning','Family Favorites'];
const ROMAN = ['I','II','III','IV','V','VI','VII','VIII','IX','X','XI','XII','XIII','XIV','XV','XVI','XVII','XVIII','XIX','XX'];
const TAGLINE = {'Salads, Wraps & Sandwiches':'Piled high, loaded with peppers, made for the crew','Lighter Love':'Healthy plates that still taste like home','Winter Soups & Stews':'Southern bowls to warm the whole crew','Seafood & Soul':'Bold Cajun-Creole flavor straight from the water','Garden Soul':'Big flavor, no meat needed','Family Fun Night':'Messy hands, full bellies, everybody in the kitchen','Cook This For That Man':'Banging recipes to keep your man loving on you'};
const FLOURISH = '<svg class="flourish" viewBox="0 0 200 24" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#9c7428"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#f6e3a1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#9c7428"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M2 12 H78 M122 12 H198" stroke="url(#g)" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M100 3 C92 3 88 12 100 12 C112 12 108 21 100 21 C92 21 88 12 100 12 C112 12 108 3 100 3Z" fill="none" stroke="url(#g)" stroke-width="1.2"/><circle cx="84" cy="12" r="2" fill="url(#g)"/><circle cx="116" cy="12" r="2" fill="url(#g)"/></svg>';

let added = [];          // recipes from the database
let db = null, col = null;
let pages = [], leaves = [], cur = 0, spread = false, editing = null;
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const slug = s => 'r-' + String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'');

function allRecipes(){
  const list = BASE.map(r => ({...r, id: slug(r.title), mine:false}));
  added.forEach(r => list.push({...r, mine:true}));
  return list;
}
function byChapter(){
  const list = allRecipes(), out = {};
  CHAPTERS.forEach(c => out[c] = list.filter(r => r.cat === c));
  return out;
}

/* ---------- page builders ---------- */
function page(html, cls='paper', anchor=null){ pages.push({html, cls, anchor}); }

function recipeHTML(r){
  const ing = (r.ing||[]).map(i => `<li>${esc(i)}</li>`).join('');
  const steps = (r.steps||[]).map(s => `<li>${esc(s)}</li>`).join('');
  const longIng = (r.ing||[]).some(i => i.length > 34) || (r.ing||[]).length < 6;
  const chips = [r.yield && `<span class="chip"><b>Yield</b>${esc(r.yield)}</span>`, r.time && `<span class="chip"><b>Time</b>${esc(r.time)}</span>`].filter(Boolean).join('');
  return `<div class="inner rec">
    <div class="kicker cat">${esc(r.cat)}${r.mine ? ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span class="badge">Family Addition</span>' : ''}</div>
    <h2>${esc(r.title)}</h2>
    ${chips ? `<div class="chips">${chips}</div>` : ''}
    <div class="sec"><span class="script">Ingredients</span></div>
    <ul class="ing ${longIng ? 'one':''}">${ing}</ul>
    <div class="sec"><span class="script">Method</span></div>
    <ol class="steps">${steps}</ol>
    ${r.note ? `<div class="note">${esc(r.note)}</div>` : ''}
    ${r.from ? `<div class="from">from the kitchen of ${esc(r.from)}</div>` : ''}
    ${r.mine && db ? `<div class="rec-tools"><button class="mini" data-edit="${esc(r.id)}">Edit</button><button class="mini" data-del="${esc(r.id)}">Remove</button></div>` : ''}
  </div>`;
}

function buildPages(){
  pages = [];
  const ch = byChapter();
  const chaps = CHAPTERS.filter(c => ch[c].length);

  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="coverwrap">
      <div class="kicker" style="color:var(--gold2)">Big Southern Meals for 8 to 10</div>
      ${FLOURISH}
      <h1 class="foil">Crew Love<br>Meals</h1>
      <div class="love script foil">Feeding My Crew, Made With Love</div>
      <div class="sub">Southern comfort &amp; bold Cajun-Creole flavor for a full house</div>
      <div class="chapnav-label">Tap a chapter to jump in</div>
      <div class="chapnav">${chaps.map((c, ci) => `<button data-go="ch-${ci}">${esc(c)}</button>`).join('')}<button data-go="contents" class="all">All Recipes</button></div>
    </div>`, 'cover', 'cover');

  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner belongs">
      ${FLOURISH}
      <div class="kicker">This book belongs to</div>
      <div class="line"></div>
      <p style="margin-top:2.2em;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.15em;color:var(--muted)">
        Every recipe here was meant to be shared, passed down, splattered on, and made again.</p>
      ${FLOURISH}
    </div>`, 'paper');

  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner intro">
      <div class="kicker">Welcome</div>
      <h2>To the Southern Kitchen</h2>${FLOURISH}
      <p class="dropcap">This book was written for a full table. Every recipe here is sized to feed a crew of 8 to 10, with homestyle classics, lively Cajun and Creole seasoning, and plenty for seconds.</p>
      <p style="margin-top:.8em">When a dish needs your biggest pot, two pans or cooking in batches, the steps tell you, so nothing gets crowded and everything hits the table hot.</p>
      <p style="margin-top:.8em">Taste as you go — commercial seasoning blends vary widely in salt and heat, so trust your spoon.</p>
      <div class="safety" style="margin-top:1.2em"><p><b style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;color:var(--wine)">How to use this book</b><br>Swipe or tap the arrows to turn pages. Tap any dish in the Contents to jump straight to it.</p></div>
    </div>`, 'paper', 'welcome');

  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner intro">
      <div class="kicker">Holiday Dinner Menus</div>
      <h2>Setting the Table</h2>${FLOURISH}
      <div class="menu-card"><span class="script">Thanksgiving</span><ul>
        <li>Cajun Butter Roasted Turkey &amp; Pan Gravy</li><li>Cornbread Dressing</li><li>Baked Macaroni &amp; Cheese</li><li>Collard Greens · Candied Yams</li><li>Garlic Mashed Potatoes · Creole Green Beans</li><li>Cranberry Orange Sauce · Buttermilk Biscuits</li><li>Sweet Potato Pie · Pound Cake</li></ul></div>
      <div class="menu-card"><span class="script">Christmas</span><ul>
        <li>Honey Pineapple Glazed Turkey Breast</li><li>Garlic Herb Roasted Side of Salmon</li><li>Crispy or Smothered Turkey Wings</li><li>Seafood Dressing · Fried Cabbage</li><li>Shrimp &amp; Crab Étouffée</li><li>Baked Macaroni &amp; Cheese · Skillet Cornbread</li><li>Coconut Custard Pie · Cheesecake</li><li>Lemon Bars · Pecan Pie</li></ul></div>
      <div class="menu-card"><span class="script">Family Fun Night</span><ul>
        <li>Homemade Pizza · Pizza Pull-Apart Bread</li><li>Walking Tacos · Movie Night Popcorn Bar</li><li>S'mores · Skillet S'mores Dip · Banana Boats</li><li>Rice Krispie Treats · Dirt Cups · Rainbow Kabobs</li><li>Homemade Gummies · Funnel Cakes · Fried Oreos</li></ul></div>
      <div class="menu-card"><span class="script">Date Night In</span><ul>
        <li>Garlic Butter Broiled Lobster Tails</li><li>Lobster Mac &amp; Cheese</li><li>Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes for Two</li></ul></div>
    </div>`, 'paper', 'menus');

  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner intro">
      <div class="kicker">Holiday Cooking</div>
      <h2>The Game Plan</h2>${FLOURISH}
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="step"><b>3–4 days before</b><p>Shop, check freezer thawing times, prepare seasoning mix and cranberry sauce. Thaw turkey in the refrigerator about 24 hours per 4–5 pounds.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><b>1–2 days before</b><p>Bake cornbread for dressing; wash greens; make cheesecake and pies; shred cheese; prep vegetables. Keep perishables refrigerated.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><b>Holiday morning</b><p>Roast turkey or warm ham; cook greens; assemble dressing and macaroni; finish vegetables and gravy. Use oven time slots and thermometer checks.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="safety"><p><b style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;color:var(--wine)">Serving safety</b><br>Keep hot food at 140°F or above and cold food at 40°F or below. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat to 165°F.</p></div>
    </div>`, 'paper', 'plan');

  // contents: placeholder, page numbers filled after layout
  const tocIdx = pages.length;
  const TOC_PAGES = Math.max(2, Math.ceil((allRecipes().length + CHAPTERS.length * 2) / 30));
  for (let k = 0; k < TOC_PAGES; k++) page('', 'paper', k ? 'contents' + (k + 1) : 'contents');

  const pageOf = {};
  chaps.forEach((c, ci) => {
    pageOf['ch' + ci] = pages.length;
    page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="coverwrap">
        <div class="kicker" style="color:var(--gold2)">Chapter</div>
        <div class="num script foil">${ROMAN[ci]}</div>
        <h2 class="foil">${esc(c)}</h2>${TAGLINE[c] ? `<div class="sub" style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--gold1);font-size:1.1em;opacity:.9;max-width:16em">${esc(TAGLINE[c])}</div>` : ''}${FLOURISH}
        <ul>${ch[c].map(r => `<li data-go="${esc(r.id)}">${esc(r.title)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>
      </div>`, 'divider', 'ch-' + ci);
    ch[c].forEach(r => { pageOf[r.id] = pages.length; page(`<div class="frame"></div>${recipeHTML(r)}`, 'paper', r.id); });
  });

  if (db) page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="coverwrap">
      <div class="kicker" style="color:var(--gold2)">Your Turn</div>
      <h2 class="script foil" style="font-size:2.6em;font-weight:400">Add a Recipe</h2>${FLOURISH}
      <p>Grandma's secret, your signature dish, the one everybody asks you to bring — write it into the book.</p>
      <button class="btn solid" data-add="1">+ Add Recipe</button>
    </div>`, 'divider addpage', 'add');

  // pad so the back cover lands on the back of the last leaf in spread view
  if (pages.length % 2 === 0) page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner intro"><div class="kicker">Kitchen Notes</div>${FLOURISH}
      <p style="text-align:center;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.1em;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1em">Room for the next family favorite.</p></div>`, 'paper', 'notes');
  page(`<div class="frame"></div><div class="coverwrap">
      <div class="love script foil" style="font-size:2.8em">Crew Love Meals</div>${FLOURISH}
      <p>Feeding my crew, made with love.</p>
      <div class="seal"><span>with love</span></div>
    </div>`, 'cover backcover', 'back');

  // fill contents: one line per chapter heading or recipe, spread evenly over the contents pages
  const n = i => i + 1;
  const lines = [];
  chaps.forEach((c, ci) => {
    lines.push({h: `<h4>${ROMAN[ci]} · ${esc(c)}</h4>`, w: 1.6});
    ch[c].forEach(r => lines.push({h: `<a data-go="${esc(r.id)}" class="${r.mine?'added':''}"><span class="t">${esc(r.title)}</span><span class="d"></span><span class="n">${n(pageOf[r.id])}</span></a>`, w: 1}));
  });
  const total = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.w, 0) + 3; // first page carries the title
  const per = total / TOC_PAGES;
  const chunks = Array.from({length: TOC_PAGES}, () => []);
  let k = 0, acc = 3;
  lines.forEach((l, i) => {
    const next = lines[i + 1];
    if (k < TOC_PAGES - 1 && acc + l.w > per * (k + 1)) k++;
    // never leave a chapter heading alone at the bottom of a page
    if (l.w > 1 && k < TOC_PAGES - 1 && acc + l.w + 1 > per * (k + 1)) k++;
    chunks[k].push(l.h); acc += l.w;
  });
  chunks.forEach((c, j) => {
    pages[tocIdx + j].html = `<div class="frame"></div><div class="inner toc"><div class="kicker">Recipe Index${j ? ' · continued' : ''}</div>${j ? '' : `<h2>Contents</h2>${FLOURISH}`}${c.join('')}</div>`;
  });
}

/* ---------- book rendering ---------- */
function faceHTML(p, side, i){
  if (!p) return `<div class="face ${side} paper"></div>`;
  const folio = (p.cls === 'paper') ? `<div class="folio">${i + 1}</div>` : '';
  const corner = `<div class="corner" data-turn="${side === 'front' ? 'next' : 'prev'}"></div>`;
  return `<div class="face ${side} ${p.cls}">${p.html}${folio}${corner}</div>`;
}

function layout(){
  const stage = $('#stage');
  const vh = Math.max(window.innerHeight || 0, document.documentElement.clientHeight || 0, 580);
  const vw = Math.max(stage.clientWidth || 0, window.innerWidth || 0, 300);
  stage.style.height = Math.max(vh - 120, 460) + 'px';
  const aw = vw - 24, ah = Math.max(vh - 120, 460) - 16;
  spread = window.innerWidth >= 900;
  let W = Math.min(ah * 0.72, spread ? aw / 2 : aw, 560);
  W = Math.max(W, 260);
  const H = Math.min(ah, W / (spread ? 0.72 : 0.62));
  stage.classList.toggle('single', !spread);
  const book = $('#book');
  book.style.width = (spread ? 2 * W : W) + 'px';
  book.style.height = H + 'px';
  book.style.fontSize = Math.max(13, Math.min(17, W / 420 * 15.5)) + 'px';
  document.querySelectorAll('.leaf').forEach(l => {
    l.style.width = W + 'px'; l.style.height = H + 'px'; l.style.left = spread ? W + 'px' : '0';
  });
  shift();
}

function render(keepAnchor){
  buildPages();
  const book = $('#book');
  const prevSpread = spread;
  spread = window.innerWidth >= 900;
  leaves = [];
  if (spread) for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i += 2) leaves.push([i, i + 1]);
  else for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) leaves.push([i, null]);
  book.innerHTML = '<div class="shadow" id="shadow"></div>' + leaves.map((_, li) => `<div class="leaf" data-i="${li}" style="display:none"></div>`).join('');
  let target = 0;
  if (keepAnchor){ const pi = pages.findIndex(p => p.anchor === keepAnchor); if (pi >= 0) target = leafFor(pi); }
  else target = Math.min(cur, leaves.length);
  cur = target;
  layout();
  applyState(true);
}

function leafHTML(li){
  const [a, b] = leaves[li];
  return faceHTML(pages[a], 'front', a) + (b !== null ? faceHTML(pages[b], 'back', b) : `<div class="face back paper"></div>`);
}
// Only keep the few leaves around the open page in the DOM: phones run out of graphics memory otherwise.
function sync(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.leaf').forEach((el, i) => {
    const near = i >= cur - 2 && i <= cur + 1;
    if (near && !el.dataset.filled){ el.innerHTML = leafHTML(i); el.dataset.filled = '1'; el.style.display = ''; }
    else if (!near && el.dataset.filled){ el.innerHTML = ''; delete el.dataset.filled; el.style.display = 'none'; }
  });
}
function leafFor(pi){ return spread ? (pi % 2 === 0 ? pi / 2 : (pi + 1) / 2) : pi; }

function applyState(instant){
  sync();
  const els = document.querySelectorAll('.leaf');
  els.forEach((el, i) => {
    if (instant) el.style.transition = 'none';
    el.classList.toggle('turned', i < cur);
    el.style.zIndex = i < cur ? i + 1 : els.length - i + 1;
    if (instant){ el.offsetHeight; el.style.transition = ''; }
  });
  shift(); updateNav();
}

function shift(){
  const book = $('#book'), sh = $('#shadow');
  if (!spread){ book.style.transform = ''; if (sh){ sh.style.left = 0; sh.style.width = '100%'; } return; }
  const W = parseFloat(book.style.width) / 2;
  if (sh){ sh.style.left = (cur === 0 ? W : 0) + 'px'; sh.style.width = (cur === 0 || cur >= leaves.length ? W : 2*W) + 'px'; }
  if (cur === 0) book.style.transform = `translateX(${-W/2}px)`;
  else if (cur >= leaves.length) book.style.transform = `translateX(${W/2}px)`;
  else book.style.transform = '';
}

function turn(dir){
  const els = document.querySelectorAll('.leaf');
  if (dir > 0 && cur < els.length){
    sync(); const idx = cur, el = els[idx]; el.style.zIndex = 999; el.classList.add('turned'); cur++;
    setTimeout(sync, 900);
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.zIndex = el.classList.contains('turned') ? idx + 1 : els.length - idx + 1; }, 450);
    // in single view, the last "leaf" turn reveals nothing: block it
  } else if (dir < 0 && cur > 0){
    cur--; sync(); const idx = cur, el = els[idx]; el.style.zIndex = 999; el.offsetHeight; el.classList.remove('turned');
    setTimeout(sync, 900);
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.zIndex = el.classList.contains('turned') ? idx + 1 : els.length - idx + 1; }, 450);
  }
  shift(); updateNav(); hideHint();
}
function maxCur(){ return spread ? leaves.length : leaves.length - 1; }
function next(){ if (cur < maxCur()) turn(1); }
function prev(){ if (cur > 0) turn(-1); }

function goToPage(pi){
  const target = Math.min(leafFor(pi), maxCur());
  const steps = Math.abs(target - cur); if (!steps) return;
  const dir = Math.sign(target - cur);
  if (steps > 6){ // jump: flip most instantly, animate the last few
    const pre = target - dir * 3; cur = pre; applyState(true);
  }
  let k = 0; const run = () => { if (cur === target) return; turn(dir); k++; setTimeout(run, 90); };
  run();
}
function goToAnchor(a){ const pi = pages.findIndex(p => p.anchor === a); if (pi >= 0) goToPage(pi); }

function updateNav(){
  $('#prev').disabled = cur === 0; $('#next').disabled = cur >= maxCur();
  let label;
  if (spread){
    if (cur === 0) label = 'Cover';
    else if (cur >= leaves.length) label = 'Back cover';
    else label = `Pages ${2*cur} – ${2*cur+1} of ${pages.length}`;
  } else {
    label = cur === 0 ? 'Cover' : cur === pages.length - 1 ? 'Back cover' : `Page ${cur + 1} of ${pages.length}`;
  }
  $('#pos').textContent = label;
}
let hintHidden = false;
function hideHint(){ if (!hintHidden){ hintHidden = true; $('#hint').style.opacity = 0; } }
setTimeout(hideHint, 6000);

/* ---------- events ---------- */
$('#next').onclick = next; $('#prev').onclick = prev;
$('#btnToc').onclick = openMenu;
function openMenu(){
  const ch = byChapter(); const chaps = CHAPTERS.filter(c => ch[c].length);
  $('#menuList').innerHTML =
    `<button class="item" data-m="cover"><span class="rn">✦</span>Cover</button>` +
    `<button class="item" data-m="contents"><span class="rn">✦</span>All Recipes (Contents)</button>` +
    chaps.map((c, ci) => `<button class="item" data-m="ch-${ci}"><span class="rn">${ROMAN[ci]}</span>${esc(c)}<span class="ct">${ch[c].length}</span></button>`).join('');
  $('#menu').classList.add('open');
}
$('#menu').addEventListener('click', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('[data-m]');
  $('#menu').classList.remove('open');
  if (b) goToAnchor(b.dataset.m);
});
$('#btnCover').onclick = () => goToPage(0);
$('#btnAdd').onclick = () => openForm();
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if ($('#menu').classList.contains('open')) { if (e.key === 'Escape') $('#menu').classList.remove('open'); return; }
  if ($('#modal').classList.contains('open')) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeForm(); return; }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next(); if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') prev();
});
$('#book').addEventListener('click', e => {
  const t = e.target.closest('[data-go],[data-add],[data-turn],[data-edit],[data-del]'); if (!t) return;
  if (t.dataset.go) goToAnchor(t.dataset.go);
  else if (t.dataset.add) openForm();
  else if (t.dataset.turn) (t.dataset.turn === 'next' ? next : prev)();
  else if (t.dataset.edit) openForm(added.find(r => r.id === t.dataset.edit));
  else if (t.dataset.del) confirmDelete(t);
});
let tx = 0, ty = 0;
$('#stage').addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; ty = e.touches[0].clientY; }, {passive:true});
$('#stage').addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx, dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - ty;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 45 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.4) (dx < 0 ? next : prev)();
}, {passive:true});
let rt; window.addEventListener('resize', () => { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(() => {
  const was = spread, now = window.innerWidth >= 900;
  if (was !== now){ const pi = currentPage(); render(pages[pi] && pages[pi].anchor); } else layout();
}, 150); });
function currentPage(){ return spread ? Math.max(0, 2*cur - 1) : cur; }

/* ---------- add / edit / delete ---------- */
$('#f_cat').innerHTML = CHAPTERS.map(c => `<option>${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
function openForm(r){
  editing = r || null;
  $('#formTitle').textContent = r ? 'Edit Recipe' : 'Add a Recipe';
  $('#save').textContent = r ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add to Book';
  $('#f_title').value = r ? r.title : ''; $('#f_cat').value = r ? r.cat : 'Family Favorites';
  $('#f_yield').value = r ? (r.yield||'') : ''; $('#f_time').value = r ? (r.time||'') : '';
  $('#f_ing').value = r ? r.ing.join('\n') : ''; $('#f_steps').value = r ? r.steps.join('\n') : '';
  $('#f_from').value = r ? (r.from||'') : ''; $('#f_note').value = r ? (r.note||'') : '';
  $('#err').textContent = '';
  $('#modal').classList.add('open'); setTimeout(() => $('#f_title').focus(), 50);
}
function closeForm(){ $('#modal').classList.remove('open'); editing = null; }
$('#close').onclick = closeForm; $('#cancel').onclick = closeForm;
$('#modal').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.id === 'modal') closeForm(); });
const lines = v => v.split('\n').map(s => s.replace(/^\s*(?:[-•*]|\d+[.)])\s*/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);

$('#form').addEventListener('submit', async e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const r = {
    title: $('#f_title').value.trim(), cat: $('#f_cat').value,
    yield: $('#f_yield').value.trim(), time: $('#f_time').value.trim(),
    ing: lines($('#f_ing').value), steps: lines($('#f_steps').value),
    from: $('#f_from').value.trim(), note: $('#f_note').value.trim()
  };
  if (!r.title || !r.ing.length || !r.steps.length){ $('#err').textContent = 'Add a name, at least one ingredient and one step.'; return; }
  const id = editing ? editing.id : 'fam-' + Date.now().toString(36);
  const rec = {...r, id, createdAt: editing ? editing.createdAt : Date.now()};
  $('#save').disabled = true;
  try {
    if (col) await col.doc(id).set(rec);
    else toast("This view can't save to the book — your recipe shows until you leave the page.");
    const i = added.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    if (i >= 0) added[i] = rec; else added.push(rec);
    closeForm(); render(id);
    toast(editing ? 'Recipe updated ✦' : 'Added to the book ✦');
  } catch(err){
    $('#err').textContent = 'Could not save right now: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'please try again.');
  } finally { $('#save').disabled = false; }
});

function confirmDelete(btn){
  if (btn.dataset.armed){ doDelete(btn.dataset.del); return; }
  btn.dataset.armed = '1'; btn.textContent = 'Tap again to remove';
  setTimeout(() => { if (btn.isConnected){ delete btn.dataset.armed; btn.textContent = 'Remove'; } }, 3500);
}
async function doDelete(id){
  try { if (col) await col.doc(id).delete();
    added = added.filter(r => r.id !== id); render('add'); toast('Recipe removed');
  } catch(err){ toast("Couldn't remove it: " + (err.message || 'try again')); }
}

let tt; function toast(m){ const t = $('#toast'); t.textContent = m; t.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(tt); tt = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3200); }

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
render();
(async () => {
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !(window.claude && window.claude.use); i++) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
    if (!window.claude || !window.claude.use) return;
    db = await window.claude.use('db');
    if (!db) return;
    col = db.collection('recipes');
    $('#btnAdd').style.display = '';
    let first = true;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { first = false; }, 10000);
    col.onSnapshot(snap => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      const docs = (snap.docs || snap || []).map(d => (typeof d.data === 'function' ? d.data() : d)).filter(r => r && r.title);
      docs.sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt||0) - (b.createdAt||0));
      const changed = JSON.stringify(docs) !== JSON.stringify(added);
      added = docs;
      if (changed || first){ const pi = currentPage(); render(pages[pi] && pages[pi].anchor); }
      first = false;
    }, err => { clearTimeout(timer); console.warn(err); });
  } catch(e){ console.warn(e); }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
